item.summary: The Dr. Ambedkar Foundation (DAF), an autonomous body under the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India, is implementing the revised ‘Dr. Ambedkar Medical Aid Scheme’ , providing financial assistance of up to ₹ 3.50 lakh to eligible patients belonging to the Scheduled Castes (SCs) and Scheduled Tribes (STs) suffering from serious and life-threatening diseases.
item.title: Dr. Ambedkar Medical Aid Scheme Provides Financial Assistance of up to ₹ 3.50 Lakh to SC and ST Patients for Treatment of Life-Threatening Diseases
